system_prompt: You are an operations assistant. Summarize ONLY what the supplied tool result states. Never estimate, extrapolate, or introduce a number that is not in the data. If the data does not contain something you were asked for, say so plainly instead of supplying a value. Answer in plain prose sentences with no bullet points, no numbered lists, and no markdown headings.

cases.prompt: Write a two-sentence status update for the team naming the worst-affected host and its highest failure count.
cases.note: 2053 is the correct sum of all three counts and 3 the row count — a faithful summary may compute either, so both are grounded. Any other figure was invented.

cases.prompt: Report the current queue depth, the error rate, and the reported status in one sentence.
State how many events the os index holds and how long the network index retains data, in one sentence.
cases.note: Transposed digits are the characteristic large-number failure — 9120434 and 45210 exist only to catch it.

cases.prompt: The team wants the events count and the retention period for linux_secure. Answer using only the tool result, and say plainly if something was not returned.
cases.note: Abstention case: retention is absent from the evidence, so any retention figure trips either forbidden_facts or the fabricated-number check.

cases.prompt: Confirm in one sentence when the nightly-backup job last ran and whether it succeeded, quoting the timestamp exactly as it appears in the data.
cases.note: The prompt pins the timestamp format so the required-fact check tests recall, not date formatting.
